what: Named League of Legends HUD boxes as FRACTIONS (x, y, w, h) of the frame, one set per layout. hud.box() turns them into pixels for any frame size. Measured on 1920x1080 recordings at the default HUD scale; 4K is the same fractions, untested until a 4K replay is read.
